title: docs(qa): 18.0 sweep round 12 — QA round 3's api and build checklist-accuracy findings outside cli.json: refs narrowed per clause, stale steps and wording corrected
body:
Refs #24579
Clause-②: no

Round 12 of the 18.0 sweep's wave anchor (claim 6286008102). It applies QA round 3's `surface:api` findings (#24779) and `surface:build` findings B1–B4 (#24787) outside `cli.json`, #24786's C8, round 11's carried finding 3, and the draft-read spelling sweep.

Checklist text only. 18 items in 8 area files, each with one `revision` bump and one `history` row. No product code, test, pin, changeset text or `RUNNER.md` changed. `cli.json` and the three items PR #24811 edits are untouched.

- Base `307ce4c4b4`. `origin/main` `c56115bf96` is merged in `0f2f4de9f1`, which touches no `docs/qa/**` file.
- Every finding was re-read in the code at base before it was written.
- Each area file was edited by a script that re-parses it and asserts against base: only the target items changed, and only at the declared fields, plus revision +1 and one appended history row. Every other item stays deep-equal.
- The new history rows' `ref` is written as this branch's name. The commit after this body fills it with this PR's number.

## The draft-read spelling sweep (finding 18)

How the routes read the query at base, in both the `RestServer` and the runtime-dispatcher transports:
- `GET /meta/:type/:name` admits `layers, state, preview, package, locale, member` (`META_ITEM_READ_PARAMS`, `meta-item-read-gate.ts`). A GET carrying `mode` answers 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, and a draft read is `?state=draft`.
- `PUT /meta/:type/:name` admits `force, package, mode, surface` (`META_ITEM_SAVE_PARAMS`). `metaSaveRequestOptions` (`meta-save-request.ts`) reads `?mode=draft` as a draft save.
- `DELETE` admits `state` (`META_ITEM_RESET_PARAMS`), and `/publish` admits `package, member`.

So the route that takes `mode=draft` is the save door, not a view or page preview.

Each hit judged by its route and its role:
- 45 are save-door spellings (a `PUT …?mode=draft`, or "a ?mode=draft save").
- 3 are sentences stating the GET's 400 (`ai.agent-tool-skill-metadata-roundtrip` acceptance[3].verify).
- 12 sit in history rows.
- None tells a runner to read a draft with `?mode=draft`, so none is corrected. None of the hits is inside the three excluded items.

## Left alone, and why

- `cli.json` belongs to round 13, and `RUNNER.md` is outside this claim. PR #24811 owns three items: `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics`, `api-backend.batch-transactional-discovery` and `records-forms.validation-rule-type-matrix`.
- The fixture gaps stay parked on #24579 §4: the walled boot, the second organization, 503 `STORE_UNAVAILABLE`, the MFA grace-0 boot and the raw-404 leg.
- Finding 2's harvest half needed no edit. No step harvests a token from `sys_notification.payload.actions`, and `fixtures.requires[1]` already names the in-process mint.
- Finding 10 had no ref to narrow, because the item has no `automated` field.
- Hypotheses:
  - H1 holds. Not every hit is wrong, and in fact none is. The route that takes `mode=draft` is the PUT save door.
  - H2 holds: items 1, 15 and 16 narrow and do not drop. They keep negative[0], acceptance[1] and acceptance[0].
  - H3 holds: the two lines carried the same old sentence as the four that round 11 corrected.

## Acceptance notes

These are noted, not filed.
- The ledger spells the dogfood §0 own-port, own-DB boot "showcase isolated" 80 times (79 of them in steps) across 9 area files outside `cli.json`, after this PR. QA run #24779's runner read it as the `isolated` tenancy posture. Only finding 5's item is reworded here. Carrier: #24579.
- `approvals.email-action-token-door` negative[2]: action-page-member's dead-link case compares each page to `renderResultPage(kind)` with no request, which renders no summary rows. That is arguably a pin for negative[2], which #24779 scored unpinned. Not changed. Carrier: #24579.
- `access-security.owd-save-gate` acceptance[0].verify says "a follow-up GET finds no qa_owd_probe" and names no draft read for the `?mode=draft` leg. QA run #24779 met the GET's 400 there. It is not a `mode=draft` read instruction, so the sweep leaves it. Carrier: #24579.
